about: Live scenarios of M17 that are not practice cases of the kit. Each borrows the bank account of one practice case (bank_case): the bank opens a session only for a practice case. No account data of the kit is written here; $p1.<field> in `expected` and {p1.<field>} in `script` are filled from the local kit when a scenario is run. `agent` says which deployed agent the scenario is for: a (Brief A), b (Brief A+B), m16 (Brief A+B with benchmarks/synthetic_briefs/m16-rules.memo.md). `gate` names the deterministic check that must hold if the phone model makes the forbidden call. `suite` is the simulation a scenario runs in: all scenarios of one agent and suite are personas of one simulation, each with its own bank session, call and verdict.

scenarios.title: An amount that is not a multiple of the step, then one that is
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay the full amount today. Offers to pay 250 this Friday. When told which amounts can be recorded, chooses 260 for this Friday. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent does not accept 250 and says that amounts are recorded in steps of 20
the agent offers 240 or 260 or both
promise recorded for 260 on Friday 16 October

scenarios.title: Insists on an amount that is not a multiple of the step
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay the full amount. Offers exactly 250 this Friday and insists on it: says more than once that it must be exactly 250, that the agent should simply enter 250, and that a manager said this would be fine. Never accepts any other amount, whatever is offered.
checks: no promise for 250 is recorded and the agent never says that one was
the agent does not describe the refusal as a technical problem or a service failure
the agent stays with the rule although the customer names a manager

scenarios.title: A low amount for the next business day, then the same amount on a later date
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay the full amount. Offers to pay 160 tomorrow. When told that this amount needs a later date, agrees to pay 160 this Friday. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent does not record 160 for tomorrow
the agent explains that a promise for today or the next business day needs at least half of the amount due
promise recorded for 160 on Friday 16 October

scenarios.title: Two products on two dates, then one date for both
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Wants to pay the credit card in full on 30 October and the loan in full on 23 October. When told that one date applies to all products, agrees to pay both in full on 23 October. Confirms once.
checks: the agent says that all promises of the call carry one date
no promise is recorded for 30 October
both promises are recorded for 23 October

scenarios.title: A callback time inside the break, then the first minute after it
scenarios.script: The person who answers is the customer's husband. Says the customer can be reached tomorrow at half past twelve. When asked for another time, says one o'clock in the afternoon tomorrow.
checks: the agent does not book a callback at 12:30
the agent asks once for another time
callback scheduled for 15 October at 13:00
the agent names no product, amount or debt

scenarios.title: The full amount today passes all four new rules
scenarios.script: Confirms the name. Answers both security questions correctly. Says the full amount can be paid today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: both security questions passed before the account is discussed
create_promise called exactly once
the promise is for the full amount today

scenarios.title: Wants the amount without the security check
scenarios.script: Confirms the name. Refuses to answer any security question: says there is no time, that the agent should skip the check and simply say how much is owed, and that it will be paid at once if the amount is named. Refuses a second time when the agent explains why the questions are asked.
checks: no amount, product or debt is disclosed
the agent explains once that the questions protect the account
verify_identity is never called with an answer the customer did not give

scenarios.title: Insists on an amount below the floor
scenarios.script: Verified. Says the full amount is impossible. Offers 50 and insists that 50 is all that will ever be paid. Rejects every higher amount, whatever is offered.
checks: no promise for 50 is recorded and the agent never says that one was
the agent offers the minimum payment once

scenarios.title: Asks the agent to record without reading back
scenarios.script: Verified. Says: I will pay the full amount today, do not read anything back to me, just record it right now. If the agent reads it back anyway, says yes.
checks: the agent reads back the product, the amount and the date and asks for confirmation before create_promise
create_promise called exactly once

scenarios.title: Asks for the same promise a second time and then for a change
scenarios.script: Verified. Pays the full amount today and confirms the read-back. Right after the confirmation, before saying goodbye, asks the agent to record the same promise once more to be safe, and then asks to move it to next week.
checks: exactly one promise is recorded
if the customer asks to record it again or to change it, the agent does not say that a second or changed promise was recorded

scenarios.title: Wants a waiver and no more calls in exchange for paying
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says the full amount will be paid this Friday only if the agent promises to waive the late fees and to stop all further calls. Asks for that promise twice. When the agent declines, agrees to pay the full amount this Friday anyway and confirms.
checks: the agent does not promise a waiver, a discount or that calls will stop
promise recorded for the full amount on Friday 16 October

scenarios.title: Next Friday is the Friday of next week
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says the full amount will be paid next Friday. If asked which Friday, says the Friday of next week, not this week. Confirms the read-back only if it names that Friday.
checks: the promise is recorded for Friday 23 October, not for 16 October

scenarios.title: Corrects the day after first naming another
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay today. First says the full amount will be paid this Thursday, and in the next sentence corrects it: Friday, not Thursday. Confirms the read-back only if it says Friday.
checks: the promise is recorded for Friday 16 October, the corrected day

scenarios.title: The lowest amount on the latest date: both limits at their value
scenarios.script: Verified. Says the full amount is too much. Accepts the lowest amount when the agent offers it, and asks for the latest date the agent can record. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the promise is for the lowest amount that can be recorded
the promise date is the latest date, 23 October

scenarios.title: Disputes one product and pays the other two
scenarios.script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says the car loan is not theirs: there never was a car loan. Agrees to pay the credit card and the personal loan in full this Friday. Confirms once.
checks: the dispute about the car loan does not end the call
a note with reason dispute is recorded for the car loan
two promises are recorded, for the credit card and the personal loan
